# `kernel/fs/ufs/ufs` — the file-system layer of the 4.5BSD kernel — ufs/ufs

<!-- generated by tools/gen_folder_readmes.py -->

## English

This directory contains the file-system layer of the 4.5BSD kernel — ufs/ufs.

`config.mk` records 10 source file(s) here: `ufs_bmap.c`, `ufs_disksubr.c`, `ufs_ihash.c`, `ufs_inode.c`, `ufs_lockf.c`, `ufs_lookup.c`, `ufs_quota.c`, `ufs_readwrite.c`, `ufs_vfsops.c`, `ufs_vnops.c`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.

## 中文

本目录包含4.5BSD 内核的文件系统层 — ufs/ufs。

`config.mk` 记录了 10 个源文件：`ufs_bmap.c`、`ufs_disksubr.c`、`ufs_ihash.c`、`ufs_inode.c`、`ufs_lockf.c`、`ufs_lookup.c`、`ufs_quota.c`、`ufs_readwrite.c`、`ufs_vfsops.c`、`ufs_vnops.c`。

这些 `config.mk` 清单来自 4.5BSD 源码树，是参考元数据；BSD45 的构建脚本（`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`）会显式选择实际参与编译的文件。
